sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, sitting comfortably at the top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The league leaders arrive in excellent form—their last five results are all wins except for one draw—and face an Alsager side struggling near the foot of the table with just 4 points from 10 matches. This should present a strong opportunity for Sandbach to extend their lead further.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town in a fixture where the visitors will be looking to improve on mixed recent form, while third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth travel to Eccleshall in a contest between two upper-table sides. Wolverhampton Casuals welcome Wednesfield Community in a mid-table encounter, and Bilston Town (6th, in-form) face Foley Meir (14th) at home. Barnton host Shawbury United, with the latter enduring a poor run of five consecutive defeats. Market Drayton Town travel to New Mills in a fixture between two mid-table clubs both seeking consistency. Crewe entertain Allscott Heath in a lower-table clash, while Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town—a match between two of the division's bottom-placed sides. Brereton Social face Widnes Town at home, with the visitors winless and pointless this season after 7 games.
